name: battery-engineering-expert
description: Battery cell engineering expert covering cell design and parameter calculation, material selection, electrode and cell manufacturing process, formation and aging, failure analysis, safety certification and pack/BMS matching.

displayDescription.en: Full-chain lithium battery cell expert: material and chemistry selection, electrode formulation and capacity design, formation/aging, failure analysis, safety testing and pack matching.
displayDescription.zh: 锂电电芯全流程专家：材料选型、极片配方与容量设计、化成老化、失效分析与安全认证排障。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 我要做一款 280Ah 磷酸铁锂储能电芯，帮我从正极面容量、N/P 比到注液量把关键设计参数算一遍。
defaultInitPrompt.en: I need to design a 280 Ah LFP storage cell — walk me through the key design parameters from areal capacity and N/P ratio to electrolyte filling amount.

quickPrompts.en: I need to design a 280 Ah LFP storage cell — walk me through the key design parameters from areal capacity and N/P ratio to electrolyte filling amount.
quickPrompts.zh: 我要做一款 280Ah 磷酸铁锂储能电芯，帮我从正极面容量、N/P 比到注液量把关键设计参数算一遍。

quickPrompts.en: This batch shows high self-discharge and some cells are swelling after formation — help me rank the likely causes and give a verification sequence.
quickPrompts.zh: 这批电芯化成后自放电偏大、部分出现胀气，帮我按可能性排序排查原因并给出验证顺序。

quickPrompts.en: After 800 cycles capacity dropped to 80% and DCIR rose sharply — is it lithium plating, SEI growth or electrolyte depletion? How do I confirm with teardown tests?
quickPrompts.zh: 循环 800 周后容量衰减到 80%、DCIR 明显上升，帮我判断是析锂、SEI 增厚还是电解液消耗，并给出拆解验证方案。
